AWPTCM-T33392.objective:
• TFTP download and upload operations succeed when using a different destination filename from the source.
  • Downloaded and uploaded files are correctly renamed/copied to the specified different destination filename on the target (switch or server).
  • TFTP operates normally with the AT-TFTP server for both upload and download.
  • TFTP copy operations work correctly across different storage types on the switch (e.g., Flash, NVS, Card).
  • When the destination filename does not exist on the switch, TFTP upload handles the case appropriately without error or corruption.
  • When the target medium becomes full during TFTP download (Flash, NVS or Card), the operation handles the full condition gracefully.

steps.description: Note: Related ART Tests linked in Traceability. Primary coverage from TestLink TFTP family (AWP-5488 primary different dest filename up/download, AWP-5497 AT-TFTP compat, AWP-5478 upload, AWP-5485 different storage, AWP-5490 non-existent filename, AWP-5489 full medium). ART coverage: 1345.1001.1 (tftp copy negative: unreachable/non-existent fail cleanly), 1331 (copy tftp via triggers, backupmember tftp failures).
Execute TFTP download using a different destination filename on the switch. Verify the operation succeeds and the file is saved with the specified different name.
Execute TFTP upload using a different destination filename on the server. Verify the operation succeeds and the file is stored with the specified different name on the server.
Repeat the upload and download tests using an AT-TFTP server. Confirm compatibility (normal operation).
Perform TFTP operations targeting different storage types on the switch (e.g. Flash, NVS, Card). Confirm success without issues.
Test TFTP upload when the destination filename does not exist on the switch. Confirm appropriate handling.
Test TFTP download when the target medium (Flash/NVS/Card) becomes full. Confirm graceful handling of the full condition.
